title: Dooly: Configuration-Agnostic, Redundancy-Aware Profiling for LLM Inference Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2605.07985v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Selecting the optimal LLM inference configuration requires evaluation across hardware, serving engines, attention backends, and model architectures, since no single choice performs best across all workloads. Profile-based simulators are the standard tool, yet they hardcode their operation set to a specific configuration and re-profile every operation from scratch, making exploration prohibitively expensive. This cost stems from a missing structural understanding: every input dimension of each operation is fixed by the model configuration or determined by the incoming request. Many model-configuration values (e.g., head size, layer count) recur across models, so the same operation runs in many configurations; a single sweep over the request-dependent dimensions can serve them all. We present Dooly, which exploits this structure to achieve configuration-agnostic, redundancy-aware profiling. Dooly performs a single inference pass,

translated_title: Dooly：面向LLM推理模拟的配置无关、冗余感知的性能剖析方法
translated_abstract: 选择最优的LLM推理配置需要在硬件、服务引擎、注意力后端和模型架构之间进行全面评估，因为没有单一配置能在所有工作负载下都表现最佳。基于剖析的模拟器是标准工具，但它们将操作集硬编码为特定配置，并且每次都要从头重新剖析每个操作，使得配置探索的成本高得令人望而却步。这种成本源于缺乏对结构的理解：每个操作的每个输入维度都由模型配置固定或由传入请求决定。许多模型配置值（如头大小、层数）在不同模型间重复出现，因此相同的操作会在许多配置中运行；对依赖请求的维度只需进行一次扫描即可服务于所有这些配置。我们提出了Dooly，它利用这种结构性规律实现了配置无关、冗余感知的剖析。Dooly只需执行单次推理过程（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Dooly利用操作输入维度由模型配置或请求决定的结构特性，通过单次推理剖析即可覆盖多种配置，实现了配置无关、冗余感知的LLM推理模拟剖析，大幅降低了配置探索成本。
en_tdlr: Dooly achieves configuration-agnostic, redundancy-aware profiling for LLM inference simulation by exploiting the structural property that operation input dimensions are fixed by model configuration or determined by requests, requiring only a single profiling pass instead of costly re-profiling for each configuration.
